title: sdk-samples-playbook-pulse-aug-24-2026
content:
Meeting: SDK & Samples Playbook — weekly pulse
Date: 2026-08-24 10:00am PT (30m)
Facilitator: Priya Nair
Attendees: Priya, Liam, Marta, Ethan (+ optional: design consult later)

Purpose: quick sync on the Samples/Quickstarts Playbook iteration, unblock testing matrix, finalize rollout gating for the new lightweight docker quickstart image. This doc is a working capture; rough notes, action items, and things-to-follow-up.

Agenda:
- Quick status (what shipped this week)
- CI flakes / local dev experience pain points
- Playbook pages: onboarding flow, sample template, telemetry hooks
- Rollout gating for opt-in telemetry & telemetry contract
- Action items / owners

HIGHLIGHTS
- Lightweight quickstart image (quickstart-lite) built and smoke-tested on macOS/ubuntu; size ~420MB compressed. Initial local spin-up time reduced from ~48s to ~18s for nodejs sample.
- Sample template v2 merged to main: consistent README sections, run instructions, env var table, and a small e2e script. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/278
- First round of user feedback from field pilot (3 startups) indicates confusion around API key scoping and default model picks — we need clearer in-repo examples showing hosted vs dedicated config.

NOTES / DISCUSSION (raw)
- CI flakes: intermittent failure in samples-e2e (integration test against hosted sandbox). Likely cause: token rotation in test account during long runs. Short-term: pin test tokens / rotate in the test harness. Longer-term: make the e2e harness fetch short-lived tokens fresh per-test.
- Local dev tooling: Liam ran into a Docker for Mac file sharing permission error when mounting host workspace; workaround documented but we should consider a non-mounted mode for the quickstart (copy-only) to reduce friction.
- Telemetry: Marta shared draft telemetry contract (events + schema). Concern: opt-in vs opt-out and legal/compliance. Proposal: default off for public quickstarts; opt-in per-repo via `telemetry.yaml` flagged and documented.
- Playbook structure: Priya proposed 3-page canonical flow: 1) quickstart-run (get started), 2) dev-to-prod checklist (what to configure when moving to Dedicated/Private), 3) sample-maintainers guide (how to keep samples healthy). Feedback: add a short Troubleshooting + FAQ card per sample.

DECISIONS
- Quickstart-lite will be the default example in the playbook, but full-sample (with dataset & eval harness) will remain as a separate example under /examples/full.
- Telemetry will be opt-in for public samples. Private/Dedicated onboarding templates will include recommended telemetry snippet (commented).
- For CI flakes, temporary mitigation: pin token TTL and add retry logic for token refresh. Ticket: DX-4123 (Linear).

BLOCKERS
- Legal needs to confirm the opt-in wording for telemetry notice (Marta to loop legal).
- Private deployment snippets need a small config example with KMS placeholders — awaiting sample from private-deployments infra (Ethan).

ACTION ITEMS
- Priya: update playbook outline with Troubleshooting card and link to PR #278. Due: 2026-08-27.
- Liam: implement non-mounted quickstart mode in quickstart-lite (copy-only start script); open PR. Due: 2026-08-29.
- Marta: finalize telemetry contract draft and submit to Legal for review (include suggested user-facing text). Due: 2026-08-26.
- Ethan: provide Private deployment KMS placeholders and short snippet for playbook; attach sample manifest for on-prem. Due: 2026-08-28.
- Team: add small e2e test to assert quickstart spin-up under 30s; create ticket in Linear for tracking. Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-09-03.

QUICK LINKS & NOTES-TO-SELF
- Local note: when reproducing Docker mount error, use `docker run --cap-add SYS_ADMIN` as a debug step (not for docs).
- Sample template checklist: README, run.sh, env.example, LICENSE, telemetry.yaml (optional), troubleshooting.md, CI badge.
- Remember to update Console quickstart doc to call out the new smaller image — product doc update tracked in product-hosted-api backlog.

RISKS / OPEN QUESTIONS
- Will the copy-only mode cover the macOS permission cases or just shorten debugging time? We should test on at least 2 developer machines (macbook m1, ubuntu-lts).
- If telemetry opt-in adoption is low, how will we measure quickstart usage? Alternative: anonymous download counter from images (requires infra).

NEXT STEPS / NEXT MEETING
- Sync follow-up planned: brief check-in Friday 2026-08-28 9:30am PT to review PRs and telemetry legal feedback.
- If legal review delayed, proceed with playbook changes behind a feature flag and mark telemetry sections as draft.

END-OF-DOC — informal notes:
- "Note to self: collect perf histogram for cold start + first token under different network conditions (wifi / 5g tether). Add sample that exercises streaming responses (node + python)."
- "Drop-in checklist for Solutions Eng: ‘how to demo Dedicated with 5-min setup’ — could live in playbook as a one-pager."

Attachments: none in this working doc; will link final artifacts once merged.
